method: Every assigned page was actually opened via view_image at original detail from its 150dpi PNG and visually inspected for legibility, columns, clipping, entry/letter breaks, Old English characters, and running header/footer. Text and metadata checks supplement that visual inspection.

diagnostic_scan.method: Read every displayed past-participle diagnostic and inspected referenced analysis, contextual_analysis, and scope_note for case/gender/number and prose inflection evidence. Also inspected all final-e diagnostic spellings. The complete broad prose scan produced nine records: the six excluded plurals and three non-errors listed below.

prose_false_positives.reason: Masculine in its scope note describes the referent swēgcræft, not an inflected participle ending.
Dative in its analysis describes the experiencer construction, not participle case.
Exact supplied singular predicate is also the selected citation form; its existing explicit source-predicate label remains valid.

diagnostic_scan.freeze_note: This six-record exclusion set is complete for the inspected diagnostic data; no further provisional exclusions are proposed.

superseded_inspection.finding: Pages 4, 7 and 9 visibly omitted reviewed past-participle diagnostics. Data comparison confirmed 11 reviewed past participles and negative present nis had been dropped during regeneration. Coordinator confirmed mutable repair-status replay was the cause; review paused after page 9.
